children.name: brainchair
children.description: A smug, intellectual-looking wojak with glasses and an enormous exposed veiny brain sits relaxed in a brain-shaped armchair, calmly smoking a pipe.

children.name: Brain Cube
children.description: A calm, faintly smug Wojak faces forward while his cranium opens into a transparent galaxy-filled tesseract, signifying hyperdimensional “galaxy brain” enlightenment.

children.name: wojak big brain universe
children.description: A muscular, shirtless wojak with a strained, weary expression kneels like Atlas while hoisting an enormous, veiny brain onto his shoulders, symbolizing the heavy burden of intelligence or overthinking.

children.name: False Brainiac
children.description: A crying, bald wojak in a purple shirt and blue pants exhaustedly operates a red bike pump to inflate his own grotesquely oversized, balloon-like brain towering above his head.

children.name: Hangin Brainlet
children.description: A drooling wojak with a comically oversized, hollow skull grins maniacally while fixating on a tiny object dangling from a string inside its otherwise empty head.

children.name: Log Brainlet
children.description: A bald wojak character with a blank, deadpan expression wears a large wooden log with small sprouting leaves on top of his head like a hat, his mouth hanging open as if mid-sentence.

children.name: Microwave Brainlet
children.description: A dazed, vacant-eyed wojak drools blue spittle while his pink brain cooks inside the microwave that serves as his head, with gray smoke billowing out from the top.

children.name: Wind Up Brainlet
children.description: A smug, smirking wojak with half-lidded eyes has a wind-up toy key protruding from the top of its head, suggesting it is a mindless mechanical automaton.

children.name: Boomer Chad
children.description: A profile-view wojak of a bald, gray-goateed man wearing black sunglasses smirks with cool, smug confidence, dressed in a navy shirt against a transparent background.

children.name: Chad
children.description: A blonde, bearded "Yes Chad" wojak with a chiseled jawline and muscular neck gazes confidently to the side with a calm, self-assured smirk, wearing a dark shirt against a black background.

children.name: John Maynard Keynes
children.description: The "Yes Chad" wojak, a handsome man with a chiseled jawline, slicked-back hair, and a stylish mustache, smirks with calm, unshakable confidence as he faces forward in profile.

children.name: Nordic Chad Front View
children.description: The image depicts the "Yes Chad" wojak, a calm and confident blonde man with blue eyes, slicked-back hair, and a full beard, staring directly forward with a subtle, self-assured smirk.

children.name: 19 Century Doomer
children.description: A smug, aristocratic wojak with wavy gray hair and a high-collared coat with a cravat gazes forward with a subtle, self-satisfied smile, resembling a 19th-century gentleman or classical composer like Beethoven.

children.name: doomer
children.description: A melancholic, dead-eyed "doomer" wojak wearing a black beanie and hoodie stares blankly ahead while smoking a cigarette against a black background.

children.name: Doomer Gaming
children.description: A blue-tinted, gaunt and wrinkled wojak with hollow eyes stares blankly in weary melancholy while sitting and clutching a video game controller.

children.name: Doomer Stage6
children.description: A deranged, glitch-textured wojak with wild scribbled hair stares out with wide, bloodshot, green-irised eyes and a manic red-streaked grin, radiating chaotic, unhinged energy.

children.name: Wojak Pre Doom
children.description: A haggard wojak with messy brown hair and stubble stares blankly ahead with intensely bloodshot red eyes and heavy purple bags under them, conveying utter exhaustion and sleep deprivation.

children.name: Evil Masked2
children.description: A bald wojak grins with mischievous, scheming glee as he holds a mask of a calm, mild-mannered wojak face in front of himself to hide his true expression.

children.name: Tired Masked
children.description: A weary, wrinkled, dead-eyed wojak pulls off a cheerful, grinning mask of a younger face, revealing his exhausted true self hiding behind the happy facade.

children.name: wojak happy mask
children.description: A somber, dead-eyed wojak holds a wide-grinning, toothy mask of a happy wojak face in front of his own, embodying the concept of hiding inner sadness behind a forced cheerful facade.

children.name: Computer Boomer
children.description: A smug, balding middle-aged wojak with a mustache, stubble, and dark sunglasses sits contentedly at his ThinkPad laptop next to a can of Monster Energy Ultra.

children.name: Lawn Boomer
children.description: A smug, contented "boomer" wojak with a balding head, sunglasses, shirtless torso, and an orange flame tattoo on his forearm rides a green John Deere lawnmower while holding up a Monster energy drink can, with another Monster can resting on the mower.

children.name: Chad Grug
children.description: A smug, self-satisfied caveman wojak with an elongated head and prominent brow smirks while carrying a large wooden club over his shoulder, wearing an orange animal-print garment.

children.name: Zoomer Smug
children.description: A wojak with a tall forehead, reddish swept-up hair, and round glasses wears a smug, self-satisfied smirk, exuding an air of condescending intellectual superiority.

children.name: Computer NPC2
children.description: A grey NPC wojak with a blank, deadpan expression sits at a computer desk wearing pink Mickey Mouse pajamas, holding a coffee mug with a pack of cigarettes resting beside him.

children.name: NPC
children.description: A gray-faced NPC wojak with a completely blank, emotionless expression stares vacantly forward, distinguished by his bald head, simple dot eyes, angular nose, and flat straight-line mouth.

children.name: Shower NPC
children.description: A grey, blank-faced NPC wojak stands expressionless under a running shower while a thought bubble reveals he is imagining the exact same scene of himself showering.

children.name: Twitter Verified NPC
children.description: A gray NPC-style wojak with a blank, emotionless expression stares blankly ahead, distinguished by a blue Twitter verification checkmark badge stamped on its forehead.

children.name: Rage Brain2
children.description: A pink, brain-textured "big brain" wojak wearing glasses sits slumped in a matching brain-shaped throne, sobbing with tears streaming down his anguished, open-mouthed face while holding a smoking pipe.

children.name: Rage Camel
children.description: A bald pink wojak screams in anguish with red tears streaming from his eyes while riding a pink camel that has a matching red nosebleed, all rendered in stark magenta and black.

children.name: Rage Crying
children.description: A pink bald wojak with a furrowed, wrinkled brow cries profusely, blue tears streaming down its anguished face in an expression of intense frustration and despair.

children.name: Rage Red
children.description: A bald wojak whose entire face and body are solid red glares with bloodshot, veiny eyes and clenched, gritted teeth, embodying seething, barely contained rage.

children.name: Blanket Wojak
children.description: A wojak character lies cozily tucked into bed with blankets pulled up to his chin, wearing a faint, contented-yet-melancholic smile as he rests his head on a pillow.

children.name: Clown Wojak
children.description: A weary, sad-looking wojak wearing full clown makeup - white face paint, red nose, red side hair tufts, and a ruffled clown collar - stares off to the side with droopy, exhausted eyes.

children.name: Computer Wojak
children.description: A bald, melancholic wojak with a weary, downcast expression sits at a desk staring blankly at his computer monitor, a mug resting beside the keyboard.

children.name: Covering Face Wojak
children.description: A bald wojak character expresses exasperation and embarrassment as he covers his face with his hand in a facepalm gesture.

children.name: Driving Wojak
children.description: A bald Wojak with a weary, anxious expression sits in a car gripping the steering wheel, surrounded by pitch-black windows.

children.name: Fascade Wojak
children.description: A bald, wrinkled wojak with squinted eyes and a strained, toothy grin appears to be forcing an awkward, pained smile.

children.name: Feelium Wojak
children.description: A melancholic, balding wojak sits slumped in a chair with nasal tubes hooked up to two gas canisters labeled "FEELIUM," numbing himself by inhaling bottled emotions.

children.name: Happy Crying Wojak
children.description: A bald wojak character forces a strained smile while blue tears stream down from both eyes, conveying sadness masked by a façade of happiness against a black background.

children.name: Shrugging Wojak
children.description: A bald, sad-eyed wojak with a wistful, resigned smile shrugs with both hands raised in a helpless "what can you do" gesture, wearing a collared shirt against a black background.

children.name: Wojak
children.description: A bald, crudely drawn white line-art wojak (the classic "feels guy") gazes wistfully into the distance with a melancholic expression and faint forced smile against a solid black background.

children.name: Wojak Chilling
children.description: A bald wojak in a chunky rust-orange sweater cradles a steaming mug with both hands, his half-lidded eyes and faint wistful smile conveying a quiet, melancholic coziness as he leans against a brown wall.

children.name: Wojak Group Hug
children.description: A group of bald wojak characters with melancholic, weary expressions huddle together in a tight group hug, embracing one another for comfort.

children.name: Group Of Soyjaks
children.description: A group of bald, bearded wojak characters - some wearing glasses and one in a beret - crowd together with wide-eyed, open-mouthed expressions of manic excitement, leaning in and pointing as if ecstatically reacting to something.

children.name: Soyjak
children.description: A bald soyjak wojak with glasses and a scraggly beard stares wide-eyed with his mouth gaping open in an exaggerated expression of ecstatic excitement or shock.

children.name: Soyjak2
children.description: A bald, glasses-wearing wojak with scruffy stubble grins wildly with wide eyes and an open mouth, embodying overexcited, enthusiastic anticipation (the classic "soyjak" expression).

children.name: Soyjak Crying
children.description: A bald, glasses-wearing wojak with a wide-open screaming mouth and tears streaming down his face points in anguish at a chart showing a line that peaks and then crashes, with "YOU ARE HERE!" circled right at the top.

children.name: Soyjak Guzzling
children.description: A gleeful soyjak wojak with glasses and a beard gapes his mouth wide open as a stream of Silk soy milk pours from a floating carton directly into his eagerly awaiting mouth.

children.name: Soyjak Pointing
children.description: An excited balding soyjak with glasses and a scraggly beard grins open-mouthed while pointing with both index fingers.
